data.name: Duhāiyatun
data.gender_notes: Duhāiyatun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful woman whose scent is as intoxicating as flowers in full bloom. The name Duhāiyatun carries the meaning “The Fragrant One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Duhāiyatun usually hope their child will grow to embody the fragrant one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the intoxicating beauty of Allah's creation and the fragrant essence of one's faith.
data.etymology: Duhāiyatun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Fragrant One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Duhāiyatun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: دُحَياتُن
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من الضحى، يعني نور الصباح أو ضوء النهار
in_arabic.long_meaning: دُحَياتُن هو اسم علم مؤنث في اللغة العربية، مشتق من كلمة 'ضحى' التي تعني نور الصباح أو ضوء النهار. يرمز الاسم إلى بداية يوم جديد ومليء بالأمل والضوء. في القرآن الكريم، ذكرت كلمة 'ضحى' في سورة الضحى، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة روحانية ودينية.

in_urdu.name: دُحَیاتُن
in_urdu.meaning: صبح کی روشنی یا دن کی روشنی سے متعلق
in_urdu.long_meaning: دُحَیاتُن ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے صبح کی روشنی یا دن کی روشنی۔ یہ نام اس کے معنی میں بہت خوبصورت ہے کیونکہ یہ صبح کی روشنی کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے، جو امید اور نئے آغاز کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दुहैयातुन
in_hindi.meaning: सुबह की रोशनी या दिन की रोशनी से संबंधित
in_hindi.long_meaning: दुहैयातुन एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है। यह नाम सुबह की रोशनी को दर्शाता है, जो एक नए दिन की शुरुआत का प्रतीक है। यह नाम लड़कियों के लिए बहुत उपयुक्त है क्योंकि यह उनके उज्ज्वल भविष्य की कामना करता है।

in_pashto.name: دُحَیاتُن
in_pashto.meaning: د سهارې رڼا یا د ورځې رڼا
in_pashto.long_meaning: دُحَیاتُن د ښځو یو نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا نوم د سهارې رڼا یا د ورځې رڼا معنی لري. دا نوم د خپل معنی لپاره ډیر ښکلی دی ځکه چې دا د سهارې رڼا نمایندګي کوي، کوم چې د امید او نوي پیل نښه ده.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Duhāiyatun" is derived from the Arabic language, which means "a beautiful woman whose scent is as intoxicating as flowers in full bloom." This name holds significant cultural importance in Islamic literature and poetry. In various Arabic and Persian literary works, the term "Duhā" or "Duhāt" (the plural of Duhāiyatun) is used metaphorically to represent the allure of something or someone that captivates and intoxicates the senses, often used to describe the beauty of nature, a beloved, or even Allah himself.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Duhāiyatun" holds deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It is believed to be an allusion to the intoxicating beauty and power of Allah, the creator of the universe. The Quran describes Allah's beauty and majesty in several verses, using metaphors of gardens, flowers, and fragrances. In Islamic mysticism, or Sufism, the seeker embarks on a journey of self-discovery, aiming to experience the divine presence and intoxication of Allah. The name Duhāiyatun serves as a reminder of the intoxicating beauty of Allah and the spiritual journey towards attaining closeness to Him.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Duhāiyatun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the fragrant one.
